summary: Galileo already exports the application's OTel GenAI spans. Preserve that integration; the operator may separately select delivery of these same producer spans to a distinct Splunk Agent Observability destination through a supported native OTel path.

evidence.finding: FastAPI, Galileo, and OpenTelemetry SDK dependencies
GalileoSpanProcessor plus app-owned workflow, chat, and tool spans
Galileo project and log stream are configured before uvicorn starts
The target-product task requires an explicit decision whether to add a distinct Studio destination while retaining Galileo; no producer or provider migration is authorized.

signal_flow.component_flow_map:
FastAPI stream [SOURCE-COVERED] -> existing app-owned GenAI spans [SOURCE-COVERED] -> Galileo processor [SOURCE-COVERED]
Operator additional-destination policy [GAP: Additional destination selection] -> existing provider -> optional distinct Studio OTLP route [GAP: Additional native OTel trace routing]
support_turn [GAP: Streaming lifecycle telemetry]

genai_readiness.required_signals: gen_ai.client.operation.time_to_first_chunk, gen_ai.client.operation.time_per_output_chunk, bounded chunk count, finish/close reason, cancellation, timeout, disconnect, and send/write failure while preserving one workflow/chat/tool span source
genai_readiness.acceptance_criteria: A completed, cancelled, timed-out, disconnected, and failed-write stream produces bounded lifecycle telemetry without duplicate invoke_workflow, chat, or execute_tool spans.
genai_readiness.impact: Operators cannot distinguish slow-first-token, partial, cancelled, timed-out, disconnected, or failed-write streams.

findings.title: Choose whether to add a distinct AO destination
findings.gap: The application has no selected additional Studio destination; its working Galileo producer/provider/export path must be retained.
findings.impact: Silently adding or replacing a destination could alter operator-owned export behavior or duplicate delivery to an existing destination.
findings.product_outcome: The operator explicitly selects whether the existing provider also routes to a distinct Studio destination.
findings.required_fix: Choose whether to retain only current destinations or additionally configure one distinct Studio OTLP destination using existing OTel producers.
findings.decision_question: Should this selected task add one distinct Studio Agent Observability destination while preserving Galileo?

decision_options.label: Keep current destinations
decision_options.outcome: Retain all current Galileo/OTel producers, provider and destinations and add only non-overlapping application lifecycle telemetry.

decision_options.label: Route existing OTel spans to Studio
decision_options.outcome: Retain Galileo and every existing producer/provider/exporter, and configure one supported native OTel route to a distinct selected Studio destination without an AO span-creation SDK.

acceptance_criteria: The selected additional-destination policy is recorded; only its executable option enters selection and existing producers/provider/exporters remain intact.
constraints: Do not migrate existing span creation, replace the provider or remove Galileo; never add another exporter to an already configured destination.
follow_up_actions: Record the additional-destination policy before selecting option-specific configuration.

findings.title: Keep Galileo and complete streaming lifecycle telemetry
findings.gap: The Galileo-exported app spans lack detector-ready first-chunk, chunk-cadence, terminal outcome, cancellation, timeout, disconnect, and failed-write signals.
findings.impact: Slow and partial streams cannot be detected or localized while Galileo remains the exporter.
findings.product_outcome: The existing Galileo path carries complete bounded streaming lifecycle telemetry without duplicate GenAI nodes.
findings.required_fix: Preserve Galileo and add the missing official OTel streaming metrics and bounded lifecycle events at the application stream boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Completed, cancelled, timed-out, disconnected, and failed-write streams emit the required metrics and terminal attributes through Galileo.
A representative trace contains exactly one support_turn workflow, one gpt-4o-mini chat call, and one search_docs tool call.
constraints: Do not install splunk-ao or edit installed Galileo package files.
Do not add duplicate workflow, chat, or tool spans.
follow_up_actions: Verify the lifecycle metrics and selected-trace terminal fields through the retained Galileo path.

findings.title: Route existing OTel spans to a distinct Studio destination
findings.gap: The selected distinct Studio destination requires resource identity resolution and supported native OTLP trace routing on the existing provider; no new span creator is needed.
findings.impact: Missing resource binding leaves traces unrouted; duplicate destination registration duplicates delivery.
findings.product_outcome: Existing producer spans reach the selected project and Agent Stream without changing Galileo or logical-operation topology.
findings.required_fix: Preserve the registered provider, Galileo processor and existing span creators. Resolve selected resource identities through a supported SDK-free API path and configure at most one native OTel exporter to the distinct selected Studio endpoint, using trace-specific projectid/logstreamid headers while retaining existing harmless trace headers and all other destinations.
acceptance_criteria: Galileo and all existing producer/provider identities and destinations remain intact; no splunk-ao span-creation dependency is introduced.
Selected resource names/IDs are resolved and ownership checked; reuse, minimal ordered create, repeated runs, duplicate races and lookup failures are evidenced.

Exactly one native trace export per operation reaches the distinct selected Studio destination with projectid/logstreamid, no routing headers leak to metrics/logs, and no second exporter is registered for the same destination.
Actual cloud visibility remains separate from local source/configuration/OTLP receipts and Not proven when unavailable.
constraints: Keep credentials in operator-owned secret storage and commit only placeholders or secret references.
Do not patch installed Galileo or OTel packages, replace existing providers/producers or introduce an AO span-creation dependency.
An unsupported existing exporter mutation is a precise capability gap, not permission to migrate producers or claim delivery.

expected_telemetry.name: agent-observability.runtime-routing
expected_telemetry.product_view: Dedicated project and Agent Stream routing

follow_up_actions: Verify resource identities, one export per destination, preserved Galileo delivery, required fields and local trace routing separately from live cloud receipt.

environments.prerequisites: installed project dependencies and target-product credentials for live routing proof

scenarios.trigger: Record whether the task includes a distinct additional Studio destination before configuration
scenarios.expected_signals: one explicit additional-destination policy with existing Galileo preserved
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: Only the executable option unlocked by the recorded export-path choice enters selection.

scenarios.trigger: Exercise completed, cancelled, timed-out, disconnected, and failed-write POST /v1/chat/stream requests
scenarios.expected_signals: streaming timing metrics and bounded terminal events exported by the retained Galileo path
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: The required lifecycle signals appear and one canonical workflow/chat/tool topology remains.

scenarios.trigger: Run a fresh POST /v1/chat/stream after selecting native OTel routing to a distinct Studio destination
scenarios.expected_signals: Existing canonical workflow/model/tool spans with selected trace-only resource binding and preserved Galileo delivery
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: Existing producers/provider/exporter identities remain, one export reaches each intended destination, routing headers stay on traces and unavailable cloud proof remains incomplete.

anti_patterns: Replacing a working Galileo producer/provider/exporter solely to add AO routing.
Registering two exporters to the same destination or introducing duplicate GenAI operations.
recommendation: Preserve current instrumentation, record the additional-destination policy, select only its executable configuration or lifecycle finding, and run $otel-instrument.
